name: GTM API: LinkedIn MCP Server
author: GTM API
description: The LinkedIn API and MCP server for AI agents: search, connect, message and enrich on accounts you own, with safety enforced server-side. One key exposes 250+ typed actions behind 3 meta-tools; outward actions support preview and confirm. GTM API reports 20,000+ connected accounts at under a 1% ban rate.

tools.name: list_toolsets
tools.description: List the available toolsets (domains) on this server. Each toolset groups related tools (e.g. linkedin.messaging, id.billing). Start here, then get_toolset_tools to inspect one, then call_tool to run a tool. Requires a GTM API key (Bearer).

tools.name: get_toolset_tools
tools.description: List the tools in a toolset. Default (lite) returns name + title + one-line summary; pass verbose:true for full descriptions, safety flags, and parameter names. Run one via call_tool.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Invoke a tool by name (discovered via get_toolset_tools) with its arguments object. Behaves exactly like calling the tool on its domain mount. Dangerous tools still require the two-step preview-confirm (pass commit_token inside arguments on the confirm call).
